episodes.title: Episode One
episodes.synopsis: While Katya is on her Vision Quest in Australia, we'd like to introduce you to her neighbor, Trish Thompson. She cuts hair out of her mother's garage, it's whateva'. She's fourteen days clean and sober, still smoking pot, but whateva'. Progress not perfection. Join her on an in depth tour of her part-time job at Jacques Cabaret.
